app.name: Deepdreamlings
app.short_description: Real neural dreaming on Wii, in a 3D diorama world
app.long_description:
Deepdreamlings for the Wii. The live tiny CNN from the DS version, on TV in a full GX voxel diorama world: walk the arena, step into a dream gate and watch your dreamling morph, fuse new dreamlings in the slot machine, and collect them in the gallery.
Buttons: D-pad / Nunchuk stick walk and select, A confirm / dream / spin / stop reel, B back / run, - gallery, HOME back to the Homebrew Channel. Progress saves to the SD card.
